revisions.description: Align Antigravity quota reporting with the current RetrieveUserQuotaSummary API: map exact Gemini/3P five-hour and weekly buckets to Session, Weekly, Claude, and Claude Weekly; treat a parsed empty summary as authoritative; retain legacy endpoints only as fallback.
revisions.reason: The legacy GetUserStatus/GetCommandModelConfigs and fetchAvailableModels paths expose only per-model rolling five-hour quota, which is stale for current Antigravity builds. The upstream/current API exposes merged pools and weekly windows.
revisions.author: AI
